tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, answer options at rest, the answer sheet, the setup bar, the tab bar.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Control backgrounds: inputs, progress tracks, segmented tracks, chart-map cells that are out of scope, pills. Darker than ground in light themes, lighter in dark ones.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around raised surfaces. Decorative: never the only thing that marks out a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (chips, options, inputs, root tiles). At least 3:1 on ground and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every Arabic word under study, on ground, raised, fill and every -soft tint (7:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground, raised and fill: glosses, captions, pronoun hints, the English half of a bilingual label (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and decorative marks only. Never text a learner has to read.

tokens.name: sign
tokens.usage: The accent, and it has one job: the letters that carry the grammar, revealed after the answer (the diverging ḥaraka, the governing particle, later the affixes). A letter colour: on ground, raised and sign-soft, never a fill, border or icon.

tokens.name: sign-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighter tint behind a revealed sign when it needs its own ground (the diverging cluster in a typed-answer diff). Not a container colour.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The chosen state: selected chips and segments, the tick box of a picked checklist option, the outline of the met cell in a paradigm grid.

tokens.name: select-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a checklist option that is picked but not yet checked, and of the met cell in a paradigm grid.

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text and ticks on a select fill.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one primary button on a screen: Start, Check, Continue.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Verdict text, the tick, and the border of a right option after grading; on ground, raised and correct-soft.

tokens.name: correct-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the option you got right.

tokens.name: wrong
tokens.usage: Verdict text, the cross, and the border of a wrong pick; on ground, raised and wrong-soft. In Midād it is a neutral ink, because red belongs to the sign.

tokens.name: wrong-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a wrong pick after grading.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px of this, outside a 2px gap in ground (see focus-ring). At least 3:1 on ground, raised and fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Arabic — the object of study
groups.note: Scheherazade New, hosted by Google Fonts on the web and bundled in the iOS app (SIL Open Font License). Arabic sits about 1.35× the size of the Latin beside it and never goes below 19px; vocalised lines need 1.7× leading so stacked ḥarakāt clear the line above.

styles.name: arabic-hero
styles.usage: The word under study on a prompt card. One per screen.

styles.name: arabic-display
styles.usage: The verb on a derived-noun card, the citation in a table header, root-tile letters.

styles.name: arabic-title
styles.usage: Answer options, the typed answer, the diff lines.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.usage: Arabic inside running text: the answer sheet, tips, the quote.

styles.name: arabic-label
styles.usage: The Arabic half of a chip, pill or pronoun label.

groups.name: Serif — the voice of meaning
groups.note: Newsreader. Anything that is a meaning (a gloss, an English reading, a translation) is set in this italic, so it never reads as interface.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The title at the top of a tab.

styles.name: meaning-display
styles.usage: The English reading on a meaning card, at the size the Arabic word gets elsewhere.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The reading at the top of the answer sheet; the quote translation.

styles.name: gloss
styles.usage: The dictionary gloss under a word or a root.

groups.name: Sans — the voice of the interface
groups.note: The platform face: SF Pro on Apple devices, so Dynamic Type comes free in SwiftUI. Sentence case everywhere; no tracked capitals.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The question being asked, button labels, list-row titles.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The first line of the answer sheet.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every muḍāriʿ opens with one of أ ن ي ت.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, chip English, the English half of an option.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, metadata, question kinds in the setup bar.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat numbers and the results score, with tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screens use a 16px side gutter; related rows sit 8px apart, sections 24px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between options.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and rows; between an ask and its options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet and prompt-card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen title; around the hero word.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Clearance above the tab bar.

radius.note: Soft, not round. Pills only for read-only tags.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Root tiles, tick boxes, highlighted clusters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented controls, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer options, buttons, list groups, the paradigm grid.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Prompt cards, the answer sheet's top corners, the stats card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Read-only pills: recipe chips on a cue card, question kinds in the setup bar.

shadow.note: Midād separates with hairlines, not shadows. Only things that float over the page cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A resting card or option: barely there, it only lifts the edge.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The answer sheet and the setup bar, which float over the screen.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-coloured gap, then 2px of focus. A box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: option-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an answer option, so a 28px Arabic word keeps its ḥarakāt clear.

tokens.name: setup-bar-height
tokens.usage: The sticky setup bar on Practice; content scrolls under it.

meta.note: One of three directions explored; the other two (Sirāj, Basīṭ) live in the design-system artifact. Themes here are the Midād pair: midad (paper, the default) and midad-night.
